hypothesis: Geometric light visibility improves same-model head shadow fidelity without image inputs, and preserves whole-to-part tone grouping across six identities.
identities: All six unchanged S2 identities; baseline and reserved combinations evaluated separately
lights: All three unchanged S2 lights; fixed frontal neutral camera
reference: Independent Cycles diffuse direct illumination and actual shadow rays; declared unoccluded hemisphere fill, not full GI
decision: Every scene must meet fidelity limits. On independent shadow ROIs of at least20 pixels, selected error <=85% of the no-shadow control. No artistic quality conclusion follows automatically.
